facts: Dogs who bark the most: Miniature Schnauzers, Cairn Terriers, Yorkshire Terriers, Fox Terriers and West Highland White Terriers.
Max, Jake, Maggie and Molly are the most popular dog names.
Police dogs can smell human bodies even when they are buried up to 3 meters in the ground.
Dogs have three eyelids to protect their eyes from debris.
Dogs can be trained to detect low blood sugar levels in diabetics and alert their owner.
